description: Recruitment committed; fleet has crew sufficient for departure
predicate_text: fleet crew count strictly increased since the plan started AND no 'not enough crew' warning is visible at the harbor

cues.cue: fleet crew count is strictly greater than it was at the start of the recovery (e.g. 'Fleet Crew Size 953 / 2,275' where the before-frame showed a smaller number)
no 'Not Enough Crew' warning text is visible at the harbor screen
the 'Depart Now' (or 'Supply Departure') button is gold/yellow (active) rather than gray/disabled
no red dot / red badge appears on the harbor's '+ Recruit Crew' submenu (red dot indicates crew issue)
no red bars on the fleet status panel (right side of harbor) and no red bars on individual ship rows in the recruit-crew sub-screen — both indicate crew shortage

open_questions: Does the red dot also indicate other crew problems unrelated to numerical shortage (loyalty, injury, mate roster issues)?  If so, the red-dot cue may false-refute when the count is sufficient but other issues remain.

On home-port arrival fresh from a voyage, the fleet may show below-max crew without the warning — does that count as 'has_enough_crew'?  Need to confirm whether the goal is 'no warning' (operationally safe to depart) or 'maxed out' (full roster).
